title: Onboarding regression handoff note — sprint 11
content:
Purpose
This doc is a compact, shareable handoff for the sprint-11 regression triage focused on model onboarding evals and promptset failures. Designed for on-call/triage pairing and for product/solutions to pick high-impact action items.

High-level summary
- Window: last two evaluation cycles (2026-03-01 through 2026-03-09).
- Net quality drift: +7% failure rate on onboarding promptsets (relative to baseline from Feb).
- Most regressions concentrated on four prompt families: instruction-following length, numeric reasoning, multi-turn state, and API-format outputs.
- Immediate user impact: increased fallback rate to safe model for Hosted API customers using onboarding flow templates (~2.3% traffic).

Key numbers (quick scan)
- Promptset count evaluated: 56
- Promptsets with >5% regression: 11
- Median latency change: +4ms token gen (not correlated with failures)
- Top 3 severity-weighted failures: incorrect-entity-extraction, hallucinated-dates, truncated-tool-call-json

Top failure catalog (compact)
1) Failure id: F-ONB-11-ENT (incorrect-entity-extraction)
   Severity: High (customer-facing extraction pipelines)
   Affected promptsets: onboarding-ner-basic, onboarding-ner-extended
   Symptom: model drops tokens inside PERSON entities, frequently splitting multi-token names ("Anne-Marie" -> "Anne- ")
   Delta metric: entity-F1 fell from 0.92 to 0.74 on the sample promptset
   Example (input -> expected -> got):
     - Input: "Invite Anne-Marie O'Connor to the call"
     - Expected: [Anne-Marie O'Connor]
     - Got: [Anne] + stray punctuation
   Immediate hypothesis: tokenizer / decoder merge behavior changed with new kernel selection for short sequences.
   Suggested triage steps: reproduce in unit test with exact model binary, rerun with old kernel flag, check tokenizer tokenization boundary stats (rare hyphen handling).
   Owner: Marcus Chen (action 1)
   ETA: 48h for reproduction, 5d for mitigation plan
2) Failure id: F-ONB-11-NUM (numeric reasoning drift)
   Severity: Medium-High
   Affected promptsets: onboarding-math-short, onboarding-billing-qa
   Symptom: off-by-one in small arithmetic in zero-shot prompts and incorrect rounding in amounts
   Delta metric: exact-match dropped 9 percentage points on evaluation set
   Example: "Calculate 12+29" -> expected 41, got 40 (systematically when carry-over occurs)
   Hypothesis: quantization change affects small-adder kernel precision in int/float boundary cases
   Suggested triage: run targeted numeric prompt batch across quantized variants; run float-precision microbench harness; check recent PR (github PR-1845) for kernel tweaks.
   Owner: Teresa Lopez
   ETA: 72h for microbench report
3) Failure id: F-ONB-11-STATE (multi-turn state loss)
   Severity: Medium
   Affected promptsets: onboarding-multi-turn-session, onboarding-chat-history-short
   Symptom: model forgets the last user preference utterance when prompts exceed 6 turns ~20% of the time
   Delta metric: context-consistency score from 0.87 -> 0.63
   Example: user says "I prefer metric units" earlier; later response uses imperial units
   Hypothesis: KV cache eviction or altered prefix-handling in batching path; correlated with autoscaling node churn spikes in logs.
   Suggested triage: reproduce with controlled KV cache retention toggles, check routing logs for cross-node sticky session mismatches.
   Owner: Devon R.
   ETA: 4d for root-cause isolate
4) Failure id: F-ONB-11-API (malformed tool-call json)
   Severity: High (integrations break)
   Affected promptsets: onboarding-tooling, onboarding-integration-sample
   Symptom: truncated JSON objects in function-calling outputs (missing closing braces or truncated args)
   Delta metric: function-call success rate dropped 12 percentage points
   Example: expected: {"action":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"Bug"}}
           got: {"action":"create_ticket","args":{"title":"Bug"

Hypothesis: streaming chunk boundary behavior combined with new postprocessing trim introduced in PR-1799; also seen at sequence lengths > 256 tokens
   Suggested triage: run streaming end-to-end with different chunk sizes, toggle postprocessing trim, and cross-compare with dedicated run that disables streaming.
   Owner: Jamal Ibrahim
   ETA: 48h for repro and hotfix candidate

Observability notes / where to look
- Eval dashboard: confluence link in linked_artifacts (quick index)
- Metric names: onboarding.entity_f1, onboarding.func_call_success, onboarding.context_consistency, onboarding.numeric_exact_match
- Trace IDs (sampled): see s3 tarball with per-example traces (linked_artifacts)
- Quick queries to run (CLI):
   - "select count(*) from eval_runs where promptset like '%onboarding%' and run_ts > '2026-03-01' and failure=true"
   - grep for 'KV-evict' in routing logs for the time range 2026-03-05..2026-03-09

Short-term mitigation suggestions (alpha playbook)
- Rollback candidate model variant for onboarding-ner-basic to previous kernel (fallback rule in routing policy).
- Temporary prompt-level sanitizers for tool-calls: strict JSON wrapper + length guard.
- Enable a lightweight numeric-precision guardrail that verifies small integer arithmetic outputs and triggers deterministic compute fallback for those prompts.

Action items (concrete owners + next steps)
- Marcus: reproduce F-ONB-11-ENT + post reproduction ticket with exact tokenization trace (48h). Linked PR if kernel flag proves causative.
- Teresa: numeric microbench across quant variants + produce short diff report with failing cases (72h).
- Devon: KV cache stress harness run and routing correlation (96h).
- Jamal: streaming postprocessing toggle test + hotfix candidate for JSON trimming (48h).
- Aisha: prepare a short customer-facing note draft for CS describing temporary fallback and ETA for fix; sync with solutions engineering (24h).

Open questions / risks
- Are regressions correlated with a recent serving runtime patch that affected kernel selection? (PR-1845 flagged but needs artifact matrix).
- Does Dedicated customer routing see the same failure distribution as Hosted? early signals say yes for entity extraction but lower magnitude.
- Risk of rolling fallback: may increase latency for some onboarding flows — need SRE signoff.

Appendix: quick reproduction checklist (for assignees)
- Pull exact model binary used in failing eval run from s3 (path in linked artifacts).
- Run the per-failure unit tests (repo: /evals/onboarding/unit_tests).
- Collect tokenization dumps and attach to JIRA ticket.
- If repro is unstable, attach 50 raw examples that show the issue to the ticket for sampling.

Notes to reviewer
- This is intentionally compact; if you need a deeper dump per promptset I can attach the full per-example traces and eval plots (s3 link above).
- Prefer pairing sessions for the first two owners to speed root-cause (Marcus + Teresa pairing suggested).

---
Quick log (edits)
- 2026-03-10: created initial triage notes after first evaluation cycle.
- 2026-03-11: added numeric microbench assignment.
- 2026-03-12: added streaming/JSON failure details and owner assignments.
